parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the kettle, made of ceramic, circular in shape, and fits snugly on top of the kettle body.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the kettle opening to retain heat and prevent spillage while boiling or pouring.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the kettle, made of heat-resistant Bakelite, cylindrical and ergonomically shaped for gripping.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to hold and pour the kettle safely without touching the hot body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kettle, made of ceramic, spherical with a spout and an opening for the lid.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the liquid to be heated or poured and connects to the spout and handle.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static part that serves as the main container and does not move.
